fact: Djibouti's Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation held a national diagnostic phase and a multi-stakeholder workshop for the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, with representatives of the private sector, civil society, young innovators and national experts taking part; the contributions are to feed the final text.

Djibouti's Ministry in charge of the digital economy and innovation (MDENI) held a national consultation workshop on 22 January 2026 for the first national AI strategy, with about 80 participants from ministries, UN bodies and partners, academia, the private sector and civil society organisations.
